hero_title: Cobrar lo que nunca se cobró
hero_deck: Lima Airport nunca había cobrado a los pasajeros en transferencia internacional. Diseñé y evalué el prototipo de la web para recaudarla.
hero_role1: Roles — Especialista de Innovación · UX/UI designer · CX designer
hero_role3: Alcance — Planificación → UX/UI design → prototipado → evaluación → entrega
cta_live: Abrir la plataforma TUUA en vivo
hero_rv_txt: Como especialista de Innovación, diseñé el flujo de pago web TUUA Transfer para solucionar la falta de un canal de cobro aeroportuario para pasajeros en conexión internacional, trabajando con las gerencias centrales del aeropuerto. Hoy, el sistema implementado recauda exitosamente esta tarifa a más de 130,000 pasajeros en transferencia internacional cada mes.

act0_pos_txt: Un modelo físico-digital. La tarifa se cobra dentro del aeropuerto, durante la conexión internacional. Tres puntos atendidos reciben la mayoría de los pagos; un canal web, creado solo para esta tarifa, permite evitar las colas en horas punta. Ambos terminan en el mismo eGate.

act6_verdict: The platform is live, it isn't mine, and the gap is public.
act6_lede: A year later, I reviewed the live platform against my proposal. Select any step to compare the two.
act6_cmp_cap: My proposal above, the live flow below
act6_n_data: Reordered, not removed. Personal-data capture moved from my first screen to the live flow's fourth, after the flight lookup. I read the reordering as intuitive and do not contest it.
act6_n_val: No counterpart before payment. None of the four public screens asks for an email code.
act6_n_fee: $11.86, a screen earlier. The live fee appears on the flight-details screen, a full screen earlier than I proposed, and matches in both places it appears. Fee-setting was never my decision.
act6_n_ticket: Beyond the boundary. The review stopped before payment, so the live ticket was not observed.
act6_n_home: An entry page first. The live flow opens on a homepage that explains the fee before the first step.
act6_n_elig: A click instead of a check. Eligibility is a self-declaration, "Soy ese tipo de pasajero", where the technical scope specified an automatic agreement check. To my own knowledge of the build, that check was never implemented as written; the review could not see past its boundary to confirm it.
act6_n_ctrl: Where the review stops. Public, unauthenticated pages only: one control short of paying, with no transaction submitted.
act6_method: Solo páginas públicas, sin autenticación. No se envió ninguna transacción, no se capturó ninguna sesión y no se recogieron datos más allá de lo que cualquier visitante ve.
act6_k1_x: The design, prototype, evaluation and handoff of a platform live today.
act6_k2_x: Its build, deployment and operation belong to others.
act6_k3_t: A lower fee, inside the ticket
act6_k3_x: In July 2026, Lima Airport proposed cutting the fee from $10.05 to $6.40 + IGV and moving it into the ticket. Airlines haven't agreed; collection in the terminal continues.
act6_note1: TUUA Transfer. Entiendo el mecanismo de la plataforma y contribuí a su diseño UX/UI, no a su desarrollo, despliegue u operación.
act6_note2: My stance on the fee. Designing its collection channel doesn't make me a party to the fee itself. Whether it continues is for Peru's Judiciary to decide: in June 2026, a Lima court allowed a constitutional challenge to proceed, while collection continues.
